title: Paid-only models get a clear boundary
summary:
Paid-only model balances are now explicit, Moltbot joined the catalog, and SDXL Turbo left the image roster.

Seven models, including `claude-large`, `nanobanana-pro` and `veo`, now require purchased-pack or crypto Pollen rather than daily tier grants. The model API exposes a `paid_only` field, while Play and Enter label the affected models and explain which balance applies.

The Social_Bots catalog now includes @its3li’s Moltbot, a Telegram and WhatsApp assistant built with Pollinations. It also takes a featured spot in the README.

The `turbo` image model was removed from the registry and its dedicated routing. Self-hosted image routing retains the zimage and Flux pools.
